items.translation: 替换 DataSource Bean，无论它是自动配置的还是手动定义的。

items.source: Only replace the DataSource if it was auto-configured.

items.source:
Replace the DataSource bean unless it is auto-configured and connecting to a test database. The following types of connections are considered test databases:
  • Any bean definition that includes ContainerImageMetadata (including @ServiceConnection annotated Testcontainers databases, and connections created using Docker Compose)
  • Any connection configured using a spring.datasource.url backed by a @DynamicPropertySource
  • Any connection configured using a spring.datasource.url with the Testcontainers JDBC syntax
items.translation:
除非 DataSource 是自动配置的且连接到测试数据库，否则请替换该 bean。以下类型的连接被视为测试数据库：
  • 任何包含 ContainerImageMetadata 的 bean 定义（包括带有@ServiceConnection注解的 Testcontainers 数据库以及使用 Docker Compose 创建的连接）
  • 任何使用 spring.datasource.url 配置且由 @DynamicPropertySource 支持的连接
  • 任何使用带有 Testcontainers JDBC 语法的 spring.datasource.url 配置的连接
